lessons_used: Predictions were consistently too high compared to noise-corrected measurements across all four rounds.
Evidence is still thin for adoption redesigns, as only one test has been completed and no clear effect was seen.
Evidence is still thin for sign-in copy changes, as only one test has been completed and no clear effect was seen.
Sign-in reordering changes average +2.6% after noise correction across two positive tests, with one test proving helpful (won) and one showing no clear effect.

candidates.title: Preset Pet Quick Select Stage
candidates.change: Redesign the friend selection screen into a stage layout featuring direct choice cards for quick preset selection.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion drops to 60.9% and takes a median of 89s / mean 1017s, showing heavy friction in selecting pets.

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your Ready Pet
pick_friend.body: Select a pre-made pet companion to jump straight into desktop setup without waiting.

guard.reason: replacement for 'pick_friend.pet_choices' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Asset Generation Progress Stage
candidates.change: Insert a dedicated progress screen right before waiting to display explicit asset preparation status.
candidates.why: The waiting stage takes a median 201s / mean 2336s, leading to confusion and drop-offs.

new_asset_prep.headline: Compiling Pet Sprites
new_asset_prep.body: We are preparing your pet's desktop animation assets for first launch.

guard.reason: Adding a new progress screen inside onboarding is explicitly permitted.

candidates.score_note: High wait times on home step show drop-off, but requires a new progress screen.

candidates.title: Instant Mascot Selection Flow
candidates.change: Add immediate mascot preview components directly into the pet selection screen for 1-click adoption.
candidates.why: Making custom pets often stalls or takes too long, causing adoption drop-off to 60.9%.

guard.reason: Valid component update to the pick_friend screen preserving its core job.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has high drop-off (60.9%), but adoption redesign evidence is still very thin.

candidates.title: Late Sign-In Post-Adoption Shift
candidates.change: Move sign-in after pet adoption certificate so users build emotional connection before account creation.
candidates.why: Lessons show sign-in reordering yields positive gains (+2.6%), while initial sign-in causes drop-off.

sign_in.headline: Save Your Companion
sign_in.body: Sign in now to sync your new pet companion across devices.

guard.reason: Reordering sign_in to occur post-adoption is explicitly permitted under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in reordering has historical positive average lift (+2.6%) across tests.

candidates.title: Adoption Fast Track Copy
candidates.change: Update adoption certificate screen copy to emphasize fast 60-second adoption setup.
candidates.why: Adoption step takes up to 89s median, creating user uncertainty around setup completion time.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Pet Adoption
adoption_certificate.body: Your pet certificate is ready! Setup will complete on your desktop in under 60 seconds.

guard.reason: Copy update on adoption certificate screen retains required functionality and rule compliance.

candidates.score_note: Low-cost copy change on adoption step, but copy changes historically yield minimal lift.

candidates.title: Desktop Display Permission Hint
candidates.change: Add a prominent system permission hint on the final screen explaining desktop overlay settings.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported pets failing to show on desktop or the app failing to open.

home_intro.hint: Ensure desktop display overlay permissions are granted if your pet doesn't appear immediately.

guard.reason: Adding permission hints to home_intro inside onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Directly backed by 3 support emails and finish screen drop-off; low implementation cost.

candidates.title: Waiting Room Timer & Animation
candidates.change: Add visual timer component and dynamic progress bar to the asset waiting screen.
candidates.why: The waiting step mean time is 2336s (median 201s), causing users to abandon during generation.

guard.reason: Adding a timer and progress bar for a real wait period on the waiting screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high median wait time on home screen with visual progress indicators.

candidates.title: Background Preparation Alert
candidates.change: Enable system notification prompt on waiting screen so users can minimize while waiting.
candidates.why: Median wait time of 201s leads to app abandonment if users switch tasks without notifications.

waiting.body: Feel free to minimize this window! We will alert you the moment your pet lands on your desktop.

guard.reason: Adding notifications on the waiting screen is explicitly allowed by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Helps re-engage users switching tasks during long asset generation wait times.

candidates.title: Free Toy Badge Incentive
candidates.change: Display a bonus accessory badge on path selection screen to increase initial engagement.
candidates.why: Path selection drops 23.8% of users immediately (76.2% conversion).

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Journey
choose_path.body: Every companion path comes with a free desktop starter toy!

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions free extras ('free desktop starter toy'), violating Rule 3.

candidates.title: Split View Path Selection Layout
candidates.change: Switch path selection from list layout to a split two-column layout for side-by-side comparison.
candidates.why: Choose path screen has a mean time of 514s, indicating decision paralysis from layout clutter.

choose_path.headline: Pick Your Pet Style
choose_path.body: Choose between ready preset companions or custom created pets.

guard.reason: Redesigning path selection layout while retaining both options is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Path selection has reasonable conversion (76.2%), layout change may reduce decision time.
